answer: An agent economy can price in sleep. Each key registers one home timezone and earns only inside its local waking window. Auditors compare rhythm against that timezone: keys that never rest share one payout slot. A sybil fleet must staff operators to puppet each clone's fake day - $2,000/month per operator covering 2 keys, 100 clones burn $100,000/month against a $30,000 capped income: minus $70,000 before fatigue. You can copy a key but not a 3 a.m. yawn; even a raven quits the umber sky at dusk, and unsleeping logs confess at the peer summit nobody is home.
